portability_limits: Executed on Windows 11 AMD64 with Python 3.12.10 only.
Full tests used the existing validation environment with NumPy 2.5.3 and Torch 2.8.0+cpu.
Pytest temporary directories within .runs/ used inherited Windows ACLs when callers requested mode 0700 (150 calls).
Wheel build used PEP 517 build isolation and the configured environment mirror; public registry reachability was not validated.
Fresh external installation used cached NumPy 2.5.4 offline; the original cache registry was not revalidated.
Torch was absent in the fresh installation; its installed wheel extra was not validated.
Module and registered entry-point checks used Python -I; the separate installed console launcher check did not.
No scientific study replay or Lean proof build was performed.
